info.name: MD05 production prepared fixtures
info.description: Import the private production-demo.postman_environment.json. Run Login first, then select a read folder or one workflow. Never Run All. No credentials are embedded in this collection.

item.name: 01 Login accounts
item.description: Run first to refresh USER A/B and ADMIN tokens from the private environment.

item.name: 02 Catalog and inventory
item.description: Read the prepared catalog; inventory assertions reflect the initial dataset, before optional mutations.

item.name: 03 Prepared orders and payments
item.description: Read persistent states. foreignOwnedOrder belongs to USER B; all other orders belong to USER A.

item.name: USER B cannot read USER A order
USER A cannot read USER B payment
04 Returns and saved addresses
item.description: Read initial return stages REQUESTED, APPROVED, REFUND_PENDING and REFUNDED.

item.name: 05 New ONLINE SUCCESS
item.description: Run this folder only after login, Runner delay 1000ms, iterations 1. Uses productId interactive stock and fresh order keys.

item.name: 06 New ONLINE FAILED
item.description: Run this folder only after login, Runner delay 1000ms, iterations 1. Uses productId interactive stock and fresh order keys.

item.name: 07 New ONLINE expiry 200 seconds
item.description: Run this folder only with Runner delay 1000ms, iterations 1. Waits for real expiration, maximum 240 polls; no timestamps or TTL are modified.

item.name: 08 Optional prepared-state actions - choose one
item.description: Send individual requests manually. These change the prepared dataset. Do not run the entire folder: shipping and cancellation target the same sample order.
